name: app-black-and-white-payments-app-three-screens-with-line-illustration
title: Black and White Payments App Screens
whatItIs: Three white phones at different heights: an onboarding screen with a hand-drawn line illustration of a hand putting a card in a wallet, a home with balance, transfer limit bar, Send and Received buttons, quick send avatars and a history, and an analytics screen with a hatched bar chart and one solid black bar with a tooltip, all with black pill tab bars.
whatItMeans: A strict black and white palette with line art feels crisp and editorial, and one solid bar marks the selected value.
techniques: Hatched bars with one solid black bar
Black pill tab bar with a white circle active state
Two black action buttons side by side

vocabulary.definition: A drawing made of outlines without fills.
A bar filled with fine diagonal lines.
A row of recent contacts for fast payment.
